description: Send every failed delivery again whose event is still kept (24 hours). A test delivery is never sent again. `catchUp.failed` in `get_webhook` says how many. One call queues up to 1000, oldest first: call it again for the rest. The endpoint must be switched on (409 otherwise). A workspace can make 60 resends an hour, and each call counts as one. The answer is how many were queued. A signed-in owner can call this, or an API key with both setup and read permission. A key works only on a webhook a key saved: one a person saved answers 409 `webhookSavedByPerson`, so ask the owner with `create_handoff`, kind `manage_webhook`.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: retry_failed_webhook_deliveries
title: Retry every failed webhook delivery
